verdict.rationale: Render's site says it offers 'ephemeral previews of your entire application architecture for every change' (render-docs-8). Its single-YAML Blueprint definition makes multi-service, full-stack environments reproducible (render-docs-9, render-docs-29). It also says non-production environments can be kept from accessing production services (render-docs-18). Missing for 10: explicit documentation tying previews to pull requests, details on lifecycle and teardown or database provisioning for previews, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
